items.title: Personal Shopper
items.description: One-to-one shopping sessions built around your body, your budget, and the life you actually lead — not a trend list.

items.title: Wardrobe Edit
items.description: A full closet reset: what to keep, what to let go, and what's genuinely missing, so every piece earns its place.

items.title: Body Morphology Study
items.description: A guided analysis of your shape and proportions, turned into practical rules you can use for every future purchase.

items.title: Event Styling
items.description: From weddings to work galas — a look built for the occasion, the venue, and how you want to feel walking in.

items.title: Shooting Stylist
items.description: On-set styling for editorial, campaign, or personal shoots — concept, garments, fittings, and continuity on the day.
